01896 Hege' {hay-gay'} 或 (經過更動) Hegay {hay-gah'-ee}

可能源於波斯語; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Hegai 3, Hege 1; 4

希該 = "太監"
1) 亞哈隨魯王的太監之一

01896 Hege' {hay-gay'} or (by permutation) Hegay {hay-gah'-ee}

probably of Persian origin;; n pr m

AV - Hegai 3, Hege 1; 4

Hegai or Hege = "eunuch"
1) one of the eunuchs of the court of Ahasuerus
